Direction must be counted by endpoint match, not arrowhead presence, because a backwards arrow still has an arrowhead.
The decision-exit count should verify label and target per exit, mirroring the checker's model-side rule.
Prefer a structural read over a screenshot when both exist, because a screenshot cannot prove direction or containment.
Name the read in the line: a visual-only route reports Read-back (visual) rather than implying endpoint verification.
The reply stays three lines, so detail belongs inside the existing lines rather than a fourth.
flow-templates must carry the same read-back shape verbatim, or two formats exist.

The kernel needs no format change; only the skill, asset and mirror prose move.
